services.name: Schedule of Classes
services.desc: Students may view class offerings by specific term or use GSW's Class Schedule Search to find specific course offerings. This site reflects an up-to-date list of course offerings by term. Users have the option to search by subject, course number, title, instructional method, credit, campus, level, part-of-term, instructor, start and end times, days of the week, and no cost/low cost material options. Georgia Southwestern State University 800 GSW State University Dr. Americus, Georgia

services.name: Group Fitness Classes
services.desc: are held at various times throughout the week and may include activities such as yoga, boxing, barre, and more. Classes are designed for all fitness levels to meet the needs of all members. Certified Group Fitness Instructors will lead you through formats specific to the class and will offer modifications to support participants' needs. A valid GSW ID is required upon entry to class. Community members must show a governmental ID upon entry to class. Equipment, weights, mats, and other items used during group classes are provided for all participants. blurb: Griffin Bell Conference Center is designed to make hosting your event seamless and stress-free. Whether you're planning a professional meeting, a private celebration, a conference, or an unforgettable wedding, our versatile spaces, on-site amenities, and experienced support team help bring your vision to life.
